notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.2 + Message from the team!
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed frame rate cap from 'unlimited' to 60 
[*] Fixed Football Demon Behavior while walking
[*] Added Camera Shake on Football Demon's Ground Pound attack. Feel the very pits of Hell tremble!
[/list]


[h1]A message to all 'Hell Of A Racket' players:[/h1]
Thank you for playing Hell Of A Racket! We love reading your feedback and the positive reception you've given us. We hope you continue to enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it! 

Stay tuned for more future updates. Until then, keep that racket swinging!

From,
The Helltown Racketeers Team
